python3 -B -c 'import pathlib,http.client,json,sys; token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/tumblr-operation-app/tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip();p=8081
def call(m,path,auth=False):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",p,timeout=8);h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token} if auth else {};c.request(m,path,headers=h);r=c.getresponse();v=(r.status,r.read(500000));c.close();return v
try:
 a,b=call("GET","/healthz");assert a==200 and json.loads(b)["commit"]=="20d1719089f076c91a8fc0a22ef4ceb1961fd71c","REVISION"
 a,b=call("GET","/app.js",True);assert a==200 and b"/oauth/start" in b and b"/oauth/configure" not in b and b"window.prompt" not in b,"PROMPT_REMOVAL"
 a,b=call("POST","/oauth/start");assert a==401,"AUTH_GUARD"
 a,b=call("POST","/oauth/start",True);assert a==200,"START_RESPONSE"
 u=json.loads(b)["authorize_url"];assert u.startswith("https://www.tumblr.com/oauth2/authorize?") and "client_secret" not in u,"AUTHORIZE_URL"
 a,b=call("GET","/oauth/status",True);assert a==200 and isinstance(json.loads(b).get("connected"),bool),"STATUS"
 print("ACTION=TUMBLR_PRIMARY_OAUTH_RUNTIME_READBACK");print("REVISION=PASS");print("PROMPT_REMOVED=PASS");print("AUTH_GUARD=PASS");print("AUTHORIZE_URL=PASS");print("VERIFY=PASS")
except Exception as e:
 print("ACTION=TUMBLR_PRIMARY_OAUTH_RUNTIME_READBACK");print("VERIFY=FAIL");print("CHECK="+str(e).splitlines()[0][:56]);sys.exit(41)'
